quarterly_data.quarter: HOYA results FAQ: FAQs Related to Q1 FY26 Results (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HOYA (results FAQ): there are no significant differences in EUV blank demand among customers and demand is strengthening broadly; for logic, shipments of phase-shift mask (PSM) blanks for 2 nm and more advanced nodes are increasing, and recently shipments to memory manufacturers have also increased, with demand related to HBM and DRAM applications appearing to grow

quarterly_data.quarter: HOYA results FAQ: FAQs Related to Q1 FY26 Results (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HOYA (results FAQ): Q1 EUV blank sales growth came from higher volume as well, but was driven primarily by higher ASPs from an improved product mix - a higher PSM ratio and strong demand for higher-priced, lower-defect binary masks

quarterly_data.quarter: HOYA results FAQ: FAQs Related to Q1 FY26 Results (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HOYA (results FAQ): there has been no material change in the consumer HDD market and the full-year outlook for 2.5-inch products remains a decline of slightly more than 10%; the company believes most hyperscaler AI investment goes to computing infrastructure such as GPUs and CPUs, with a limited share for HDDs, so even if AI investment slows the impact on the HDD market may be relatively small
quarterly_data.figure: 2.5-inch full-year outlook: decline of slightly more than 10%

quarterly_data.quarter: HOYA results FAQ: FAQs Related to Q1 FY26 Results (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HOYA (results FAQ): the company received nearly JPY 2 billion in U.S. tariff refunds in Q1, which lifted the Life Care and Information Technology profit margins by approximately 80 bps and 50 bps respectively; the refunds were a one-off limited to Q1 and are not expected to recur from Q2
quarterly_data.figure: nearly JPY 2 billion tariff refunds; margins +80 bps (Life Care) and +50 bps (Information Technology)

quarterly_data.quarter: HOYA results FAQ: FAQs Related to Q1 FY26 Results (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HOYA (results FAQ): MiYOSMART iQ began a soft launch in China around November 2025 and was sold in 10 countries as of Q1; HOYA plans to expand sales regions sequentially and launch in approximately 50 countries by year-end; a 12-month overseas clinical trial confirmed subjects showed no progression of myopia
quarterly_data.figure: 10 countries as of Q1; approximately 50 countries by year-end
